limits: One selected actual pinned managed OpenCode/runnerd conversation case uses deterministic HTTP and a signed software Host. It proves actual provider reservation and session/generation refusal checks under a max-three application pool. It does not qualify a paid provider or physical Host.

The temporary backend/stack timing probe is removed and excluded from qualification. Earlier watchdog failures remain private diagnostics. This passing case does not establish that the full conversation reservation, offboarding, temporal or serial suites pass.
Existing product deadlines, Source/Host/privacy/Stop gates, lease ceilings and pool bounds remain unchanged. No requirement or migration phase is promoted.
